bullets.text: Engineered and maintained React Native cross-platform app used by 10K+ users on iOS and Android.
Upgraded the application from React Native 0.77.4 to 0.88.3 while resolving build compatibility issues.

Streamlined the main feed and infinite scrolling using rendering and pagination strategies, reducing FPS drops and maintaining consistent 60 FPS performance, validated with Flipper and React Native Performance Monitor.
Automated CI/CD pipelines, reducing the release process from 5 manual steps to a single command for build generation, release notes, and deployments through Firebase App Distribution and TestFlight.
Enabled Razorpay payment gateway support, handling 30+ monthly payments with a 90% success rate.
Introduced local LLM-powered features to generate AI-assisted titles and descriptions for user-generated posts.
